messages:
Amy: FYI nightly perf CI failed on dedicated fleet after merge 0f9a3b (kernel-router + autobatch heuristic). Seeing OOMs on longctx e2e tests. Attaching logs.
Ben: Can you paste the dmesg/oom logs?
Amy: Logs pasted below. This reproduces locally too.
```text
[  123.456] Out of memory: Kill process 9876 (infer) score 125 or sacrifice child
[  123.457] Killed process 9876 (infer) total-vm:1024000kB, anon-rss:800000kB
[  123.458] oom_reaper: reaped process 9876
```
Amy: Also kernel-selection metrics show ~30% more GPU kernel hotpaths chosen for long-token batches after the router change.
Mike: Ran perf on repro VM, slab fragmentation spikes in the same window. perf top snippet: 
```text
# sample counts
slab_cache_alloc  45%
kv_cache_eviction 28%
kv_compaction_slow 12%
```
Carla: Which commit range should I bisect?
Amy: Candidate merges: 0f9a3b (kernel-router) and 24b7c1 (autobatch tunings). Stack traces point to eviction churn after router started interleaving KV shards across worker threads.
Sophia: Might be the new 'fastpath' kernel choosing larger shared buffers + delayed compaction-> higher live anon RSS.
Ben: Quick repro command that hits it reliably: `./scripts/repro.sh --seq-len 32k --load 0.9`
Ben: Running that on a c4-large repro VM: OOM after ~2.2 minutes, consistent across 3 runs.
Amy: I'm halting the rollout to staging and production. Holding new release. :exclamation:
deploy-bot: rollback initiated (rollbacks/12345) by Amy — rolling back staging -> previous stable
sre-bot: alert: p99 latency spike + OOMs observed on fleet-stage-*; escalation page: https://alerts.redwood/INC-4321
Carla: Starting git bisect between 0e1b2c..HEAD, will try to narrow to the offending commit today.
Mike: Temporary mitigation idea: reduce max_batch_size to 8 and flip off cross-worker kernel routing: `kernel_router.enable_cross_worker=false`. Should reduce simultaneous KV allocations and compaction contention.
Amy: Applied the mitigation flags in staging and re-ran the repro: memory growth slowed, no OOM in 10m stress test.
Carla: Bisect result: regression introduced by 0f9a3b — kernel_router started distributing KV shards differently which exposed a race in the compaction path.
Carla: Opening revert PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/merge_reverts/PR-987 (details in PR description).
Ben: Add a flaky test that simulates longctx with heavy interleaving across workers so this doesn't regress again.
Sophia: We'll follow up with a real fix to the compaction code (avoid double-counting slab refs + stronger CAS on shard metadata), but revert first to restore safety.
Amy: Good plan. Keeping rollout on hold until revert lands and we run full longctx perf suite.
Mike: Long-term: add CI perf gate for slab fragmentation metric and KV eviction churn rate.
Amy: Agreed — filing a ticket and will tag eng-runtime + eng-ml for perf test ownership.
Amy: tl;dr: rollback + mitigations applied in staging, bisect -> 0f9a3b root cause, revert PR open, rollout on hold until validation passes.
